item.text: {"winner":"A","confidence":"high","summary":"A is closer to the frozen public contract and has stronger verification, although neither patch is merge-ready without removing substantial out-of-scope work and routing Upload through Add.","reasons":["A declares the required exact signature: Upload(... opts ...FilesOption). B instead introduces UploadFileOption, directly violating the frozen API contract.","B also changes the exported return types of WithFilesQuery and WithFilesRequestOptions and adds a new option-interface hierarchy, despite the requirement to keep FilesOption behavior unchanged.","A preserves the existing public Add and FilesOption signatures and provides more thorough multipart, replay, validation, and error-semantics tests.","Both patches incorrectly duplicate Add's request/response path by calling Raw.Do directly. The contract explicitly requires Upload to call FilesService.Add so behavior remains centralized and consistent with future changes there, including option handling and errors."],"risks_a":["Adds forbidden association fields and NewFileWithFields machinery instead of using multipartbody.NewFile for the required single file part.","Refactors general request-body replay and caller-owned closing semantics, changing Add, Update, Raw.Do, and other APIs outside the requested scope.","Does not visibly test propagation of a failing source reader, and its Upload retry test uses strings.Reader rather than a distinctly non-seekable streamed source."],"risks_b":["Public Upload signature is wrong and existing option-constructor signatures are changed.","Adds forbidden association fields and duplicate multipart-with-fields machinery; the new ID options also omit the validation used elsewhere.","Calls Raw.Do instead of Add, duplicating request construction, response decoding, missing-data handling, and error behavior explicitly required to remain in Add alone. Its replay refactor is also out of scope and does not determine Content-Length for seekable bodies, and tests omit source-reader failure coverage."]}
